name: Kızılcık Şerbeti
description: When free-spirited Doğa falls head over heels for charming Fatih, nobody expects the chaos that follows. His family is deeply conservative and devout; hers is modern and secular — and neither side is ready to back down. What starts as a love story quickly becomes a collision of two very different Turkeys, played out through family dinners, in-law battles and everything in between. Sharp, relatable and impossible to stop watching.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Kıvılcım, who lives with her two daughters and her mother, is the principal of a private high school. After her divorce from her husband, she stood on her feet and worked hard to raise her daughters. She is a principled woman who firmly adheres to the truths she believes in. She considers it normal for her eldest daughter to have a boyfriend in her first year of college. However, her daughter Doga first disappoints Kıvılcım by saying that she is pregnant and then running away and getting married. For Kıvılcım, it is a big mistake for her to marry her daughter at this age, especially to have a child. She tells this to her daughter, but Doğa confronts her mother with the courage of her youth. Kıvılcım, who is in a desperate situation, is unaware of the real shock while thinking about what to do.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Kıvılcım, who was destroyed by the fact that her daughter Doğa married the son of a very conservative family, prefers to stay behind for her daughter for now, although she believes that this marriage will not last very long. Doğa is struggling in the process of getting used to her new life. Doğa's health problem will bring the two families together, and Pembe will use this as an opportunity to try to create an environment for families to get closer. However, in environments where people come together, differences in life and thought will come to light. Ömer, whom he knows in the conservative family, is a mystery for Kıvılcım.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Kıvılcım, who meets Ömer in a different environment than that of his conservative family, is worried that Ömer will get to know her differently. Although she says that this is not important, she is aware that she is obsessed with Ömer's thoughts. Doğa, who attends the bachelorette party organized by her aunt Alev, incurs the wrath of the whole family, especially Fatih, because the party is a bit exaggerated. Not wanting to prolong the unpleasantness before the wedding, Pembe calms things down a little. There will be some difficulties from different family cultures at the wedding, but the biggest surprise will be Doğa's father and new fiancee.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: After the eventful wedding night, everyone returned to their normal lives. However, the fact that Pembe's marriage traditions never end forces Kıvılcım's hand, and she still tries to do her best for her daughter. The approach of the two mothers about the dowry causes Doğa to be upset. The tension between Nilay and Doğa will be revealed very clearly, and the two will share their trump card. Kayhan's fiancé wearing a turban to look nice to the conservative family disturbed both Kıvılcım and her daughters. Meanwhile, the unpleasantness to be experienced between her young daughter Çimen and Ömer's son Metehan will bring Kıvılcım and Ömer together, both of them will realize that they are influenced by each other, but they will not color. Alev will try to correct this misunderstanding, as her surprise at the wedding angered the conservative family, but this well-meaning effort will cost her much more.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Pembe blamed Alev but saw that she was wrong. This wrong behavior will greatly impact both families, and Pembe will not know how to hide her mistake from her husband. However, with Nilay's organization, Abdullah will learn about the situation and will be seriously tense with his wife. Doğa, who brings home a puppy she finds on the road, never calculates the consequences of this action. In the meantime, Doğa's father Kayhan will not be idle, he will calculate how to profit from his rich descendants. Kıvılcım, who took action to find a solution to the problem between Ömer's son and his own daughter, will receive the greatest support from Ömer, as in every other issue. While the waters have not calmed down, Doğa's visit to the doctor for control will cause a new problem due to the differences of opinion between the two families. However, the worst surprise awaits Kıvılcım.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Kıvılcım, who learns that a lawsuit has been filed against him, will prepare to file a counter-lawsuit through her lawyer, but Ömer, who is surprisingly involved in the event, will try to find a solution without victimizing both parties. Ömer and Kıvılcım will come up with a number of solutions to solve the problem between their children, and as a result of these activities, they will become closer. Nilay, who wants to make her husband Mustafa shine, will again turn to her cunning ways, and she will not be able to reach her goal and will be scolded by her father-in-law. While everything is in order for Doğa and Fatih, who overcome the problems at home and the problems between them with the strength of their love, an innocent act of Doğa will be misunderstood by the Ünal family, and the young couple will come to the brink of a new crisis. Abdullah, who takes action to correct the injustice that Pembe has done to Alev, will find himself in the incident surprisingly.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Meeting Abdullah and Pembe in Alev's office will cause great storms for both families. Especially Pembe's resentment towards her husband will not go away easily. Learning that a lawsuit will be filed against Kıvılcım, Ömer will try to settle this matter before he moves to the courtrooms, and he will be successful in this. Doga's father, Kayhan, will not give up even though he is disappointed about the hotel he aims to sell to Ünallar, this time he will attempt new attacks through his son-in-law Fatih. The friendship between Nursema and Umut will start to sprout despite all the shyness of Nursema. Since there was a crisis about the doctor a short time ago, Doğa decides to walk alone on this road without asking her mother or mother-in-law. However, this is not the only decision she has made. Nature's resumption of school without informing anyone will trigger new events.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Doga's resumption of school without informing Fatih drives him crazy, and Kıvılcım, who witnessed these situations, was very nervous. Although the event does not reflect on other family members with the prudent behavior of Doga, it will cause cold winds between Fatih and Kıvılcım like never before. The fight between Doga and Fatih will spread to other issues, and the tension will continue over different issues. Nilay, who is fed by the tension at home, is in effort to turn this situation in her favor. Doğa's father, Kayhan, is on his way to doing business with his son-in-law. Returning from the brink of filing a lawsuit against Kıvılcım, Kübra will have to come together with Kıvılcım in a completely different environment, and both women will realize once again that motherhood is above all kinds of prejudices. While Doğa's discomfort with Fatih's friend environment causes great problems, Kıvılcım is at great risk by the husband of the woman who is the victim of violence.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Abdullah's heart could not take what he had been through and he suffered a major heart attack. He will hold on to life when Ömer comes to him out of curiosity, but he will have to stay in the hospital for a while. This bad event causes the whole family to come together again. Learning that Abdullah is ill, Alev returns to the city with the first plane, but it will not be easy for her to reach Abdullah. Ömer continues his attempts to get to know Görkem better. Umut gets carried away with the pleasure of making a lot of money and starts to get involved in risky business. Ertuğrul's invitation to the association will reveal the true feelings of many people. Mustafa's suspicions about his wife are growing. For this reason, he starts to treat her badly, which draws the attention of the whole family. As Nilay responds with a much bigger move, everyone gets the shock of their lives.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Angered by Mustafa's accusations, Nilay takes her child and leaves the house. She comes to Nursema, but Nursema has received the news from her mother and does not open the door. Sönmez helps Nilay and takes her home. Nilay tells Sönmez the whole truth. Meanwhile, Mustafa tells his family the details of his divorce. Kıvılcım and Rüzgar roll up their sleeves for a girl who does not want to study this time. Çimen and Gökhan's relationship is progressing, but Gökhan hides the fact that he is married. Kıvılcım is confused by what a girl working at the association says about Ertuğrul. Fatih pushes Doğa to make a decision about whether to continue or end their relationship. Umut gets into trouble with his new job. As soon as Abdullah gets up, he meets Alev and tells her that her divorce will take some time. Alev does not want to endure this troubled period any longer. Alev goes to Pembe to solve the issue once and for all.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Alev informs Pembe that her relationship with Abdullah is over. Finally, Pembe's wish has come true. Umut's arrest for fraud devastates Nursema, but as always, her family rushes to her aid. Mustafa learns through a DNA test that his son is indeed his own. However, he now grapples with how to rectify the great mistake he made with Nilay. Zülkar tries to reconcile them by offering various solutions. Due to Kıvılcım's lack of confidence in herself and her lingering feelings for Ömer, Ertuğrul makes a big decision to break up with Kıvılcım. Upon learning of their breakup, Ömer wastes no time in trying to win Kıvılcım back. Fatih and Doğa agree to divorce and formalize the process, quickly finalizing their divorce. Doğa returns to her mother's house. Pembe's concern is for Fatih to overcome this separation pain as soon as possible.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Pembe thinks Görkem is a suitable match for Fatih. Görkem and Fatih like each other at first sight. Nilay's return home has made Mustafa so happy that he is revolving around his wife. Kıvılcım and Ömer's rekindled relationship is going strong, with Kıvılcım's family supporting them. Abdullah contracts COVID and is quarantined at home. Thanks to the company's lawyers, Umut is released from prison pending trial. However, he feels very embarrassed, especially towards Nursema's family. He is very tense and unhappy. When Ömer learns that Fatih and Görkem are dating, he is very uncomfortable, but there is nothing he can do about it. On a day when Doğa returns to her mother's house after her divorce and stays at Alev's house, Kıvılcım finds a test that signals a new era for everyone.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: Doğa confesses that she is pregnant and asks her mother to keep it a secret for a while.  Kıvılcım obligingly agrees in order not to offend her daughter. Abdullah's Covid quarantine continues. Umut's depression continues after what happened to him, and Nursema's discomfort about this issue increases day by day. Pembe is very happy when Nilay returns home after reconciling with Mustafa. When she takes action to fulfill her vow, she will have to welcome an uninvited guest into the house. Regretting her breakup with Fatih, Doğa makes all kinds of moves to meet her ex-husband again. When Ömer learns that his son Metehan is seeing a woman much older than him, he takes action to put an end to it, but he cannot make Metehan listen to him. Kıvılcım's attempt to protect her daughter and tell Fatih about her pregnancy is interrupted by Alev's big surprise.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: Everyone is shocked to learn that Alev is the one who is really pregnant. Unal family discusses the issue among themselves and decides not to tell Abdullah until he recovers. Unable to recover from this bad surprise, Pembe cannot stop herself from confronting Alev to confront her. The news of Alev's pregnancy is also not welcomed by Kıvılcım and Sönmez. However, Alev is determined to have this baby despite all the negativity. Görkem's family, who are very affected by what happened on the night of the engagement, decide to end the relationship between Fatih and Görkem definitely. Umut's depression continues, and Nursema's discomfort about this issue increases. Metehan, who has fallen out with his father because of his relationship with a woman much older than him, does not care about the world. Abdullah, who comes out of his room after recovering from his illness, is determined to regain control.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: The first thing Abdullah does when he learns that Alev is pregnant is to visit her. However, Alev is determined and will not change her decision. Although Abdullah asks Sönmez for help on this issue, Sönmez does not respond positively. Abdullah also receives great reactions from his children regarding the pregnancy. Fatih, who is waiting for an opportunity to talk to Görkem alone, follows Yusuf and gets the opportunity he wants. Görkem and Fatih meet the next day and have a very fun day and decide that they cannot break away from each other. A security guard working at the canal comes to Kıvılcım and asks for help for a relative. Kıvılcım and Rüzgar take action to solve the problem. Nilay is forced to confess to Mustafa that she exchanged the gold and lost her money. Çimen cries and tells the Gökhan issue to her sister. Together they decide to tell Gökhan’s wife what happened. Implementing these decisions will make the events much bigger and produce incredible results.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: The fact that Çimen has closed up for Gökhan's sake and got married in a religious marriage drops like a bomb in Kıvılcım's house. Kıvılcım is devastated, and she is also angry that Doğa and Alev know little about this and do not tell her. Mihri's suicide attempt because of her love for Metehan will cause Ertuğrul to make a radical decision. Ömer first warns the businessman who started a lynching campaign against Kıvılcım, but when the man does not understand what he is talking about, he will take a different path. Nilay, who is obsessed with learning about her family history, embarks on rapid research on this subject. Görkem, who persuades her father, will both start seeing Fatih again and create an opportunity for their families to come together. Abdullah, who is looking for a way to reconcile with Alev, cannot get the result he wants, but he still does not give up trying. Alev will be triggered by a completely different situation and will make a big move to get a rematch.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: When Alev arrives at Abdullah's house with her suitcase, everyone is shocked, but Pembe is the one who remains the calmest. She realizes that he has come to this house to make her feel uneasy and vows to make Alev miserable. Abdullah, who cannot stand this chaotic atmosphere, leaves the house and moves in with Ömer. Ömer first warns the businessman who started a lynching campaign against Kıvılcım, but when the man does not understand what he is talking about, he will teach him the lesson of his life. Fatih and Görkem's relationship continues very happily, and their families are happy with this situation. While the family questions her past, Nilay, who believes that she was given up for adoption, asks for Doğa's help to solve the issue. Nursema and Umut decide to get away from everyone to save their marriage. Alev and Pembe living in the same house will soon end in disaster.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: After hearing from Mustafa that Alev deliberately pushed Pembe, who fell down the stairs as a result of their scuffle with Alev, Abdullah ends his relationship with Alev. Alev returns to her own home. However, Mustafa came to Nilay's advice and was forced to tell this lie to help his mother. Çimen is having a hard time in his new life and has difficulty adapting to a routine he is not used to. His mother's refusal to compromise on this issue makes him very sad. Ömer and Kıvılcım decide to live together. Rüzgar, who confessed his interest in Nursema to Kıvılcım never thought that Umut would hear about it. Nilay, who believes that she was adopted, appears before Giray, taking Doğa with her, to solve the issue. Fatih and Görkem get married in a big wedding. However, a big suprise awaits the Ünal family the next morning.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: Pembe is very surprised by Görkem's sudden change, whom she has been trying hard to marry off to Fatih. She doesn't know what to do. Although she tries to manage the situation for a while, she will have to raise her voice soon. Kayhan is very uncomfortable with the fact that Çimen did not come to Görkem's wedding and will not let go of this issue. While Ömer and Kıvılcım are very happy to start living in the same house, it will also bring some problems. Giray decides to have a DNA test done due to Nilay's insistence. Umut and Nursema are trying to save their marriage, but it is getting harder every day. Proving to Alev that he did not push Pembe and, therefore, is innocent is very important for Giray, and he will try to clarify this issue. The person who will lend him the greatest helping hand will unexpectedly appear before him at the least expected moment.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: Learning that Alev did not push Pembe away, Abdullah sets out to be with the woman he loves. But this time, he decides to hide their relationship until the right time comes. Nursema and Umut's marriage can't get back on track. Thinking that Umut is ashamed of her, Nursema returns to her father's house. Umut blames Rüzgar for the developments. The DNA results that Nilay has been eagerly waiting for finally come out. The life that Çimen risked for the sake of his love starts to push him harder and harder. Görkem's disheveled return home from his night out with Fatih is not welcomed by the Ünal family. However, the death of his mother prevents the issue from dragging on. Nursema goes to Umut to talk to him one last time and is confronted with a very painful truth.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Seeing with her own eyes that Umut was cheating on her, Nursema leaves him and quickly enters the divorce path. Abdullah and Alev's relationship is going well away from the public eye. However, this double life puts Abdullah at great strain at times. Especially wanting to celebrate one's birthday will create a big problem. Learning that Gökhan is divorced but hiding it, Kayhan wants to take his daughter Çimen out of this fake life. Of course, his biggest helper in this regard will be Kıvılcım. Giray and Doğa's friendship continues. When Fatih learns about this friendship, he becomes upset, which disturbs Görkem greatly, and an argument breaks out between them. Despite everything, Fatih starts to follow Doğa to find out the truth. Metehan gets into serious trouble with his new group, which he joins with his car. The bickering between Alev and Ömer, who meet at a party, will end in a not-so-pleasant way.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: When Alev gets angry and confesses to Ömer about her secret life with Abdullah, it will bring a different dimension to the relationship between Abdullah and Ömer. Pembe, who notices the change in her husband and becomes uneasy, sends Zülkar after Alev. But Alev will understand this pursuit and teach Pembe a lesson, even if it is a small one. Fatih will be involved in this issue and will be tense with his mother. A big surprise awaits Doğa, who wants to prevent Sönmez's matchmaking attempt. Fatih's buying a very expensive bag as a gift for his wife is not welcomed in the Ünal family. However, Görkem will not be able to tolerate being left behind in this regard. Doğa, Çimen, Metehan, Nilay and Mustafa will participate in the marathon organized by Giray's company and they will have a very enjoyable day. Kıvılcım and Ömer get married with the surprise wedding prepared by Kıvılcım.

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: Fatih, who sees Doğa and Giray kissing, becomes withdrawn for a while. Meanwhile, Görkem will not remain idle and will take revenge on Pembe and Nilay for the bag issue. While the suspension given to Kıvılcım's program leaves Kıvılcım unemployed, Ömer will come to her aid as always. He will offer her a position at his company. It will be revolutionary for Kıvılcım to start working in a company where only men work. Doğa and Giray's relationship progresses slowly but firmly. Giray, who decides to launch the diaper rash cream made by Nilay, begins to get closer to the Ünal family. The only person who will be disturbed in this regard will be Fatih and Görkem, who is obsessed with his discomfort. Fatih's seeking advice from his uncle about his feelings and Ömer's manipulation of his nephew will infuriate Görkem, and wanting to meet Ömer will cause completely different problems to begin.

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: Fatih, who learns that Görkem is meeting with Ömer, cannot stop his desire to control him, even though he does not suspect his uncle. Kıvılcım is trying to adapt to her new job, and she gets the biggest help in this regard from Ömer. Nursema's decision to enter into a new relationship hesitations infuriate Rüzgar. All his efforts to speed up the work are in vain. Finally, he couldn't stand it anymore and went to Abdullah to talk. Abdullah's frequent coming home late started to disturb Pembe a lot. She suspects something, but she doesn't want to admit it. The launch night for Nilay's diaper rash cream brings together all his acquaintances, especially Ünals. Fatih's confusion about Doğa has increased. He decides to take action on this issue.

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: Difficult times await Fatih, who has difficulty fulfilling Doğa's conditions for reunion. Rüzgar's conversation with Abdullah leaves Nursema in a very difficult situation. Abdullah will never allow his daughter to work on the channel. Rüzgar realizes the mistake he made, but it is too late. Çimen starts working at the company as Kıvılcım's assistant. The fact that Kıvılcım and Çimen are in the company makes the ties between Abdullah and Ömer increasingly tense. It will end with a big surprise when Kıvılcım and Ömer invite the Ünal family to their home for dinner. The Ünals go to the ceremony together for an award that Nursema will receive. Pembe takes action to remarry her daughter, but all Her efforts are thwarted by Nursema. Nilay's involvement in the tension between Pembe and Görkem will take the conflict to a huge level.

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: Görkem falsely accuses Nilay of assaulting him, causing a rift within the Ünal family and leading to serious arguments. The relationship between Doğa and Giray continues to develop, with Giray providing support to Doğa in every aspect. Sönmez's phone scam deeply affects his morale. Despite efforts from his daughters and grandchildren to lift his spirits, Sönmez feels terrible. Abdullah narrowly avoids getting caught by Pembe while taking Alev to the hospital after she falls ill. Learning that Kayhan secretly runs the restaurant at night, Zülkar informs Pembe about the situation. Nursema and Rüzgar realize how much they missed each other when they reunite at Kıvılcım's birthday party. Nilay gets a golden opportunity to exact revenge on Görkem.

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: Nilay's revelation to Pembe shatters her world. Despite her desperate attempt to end the matter discreetly by speaking with Görkem, he refuses and launches a counterattack. Pembe feels helpless and devastated, torn between Ömer and Görkem. In an effort to uplift Sönmez, who is deeply saddened by the fraud incident, Kıvılcım and Ömer gift him a boat trip. Nursema, wanting to reciprocate Rüzgar's gesture after the party, invites him on a boat trip, where they spend a happy day together. Inspired, Rüzgar decides to propose to Nursema. Meanwhile, Doğa and Giray's relationship has progressed, with Doğa fully embracing the flow. Tensions run high during a dinner at the Abdullahs, and a small spark ignites a major conflict among everyone present.

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: It’s as if a bomb has gone off in the Ünal household. The shocking truth they uncover shakes all their relationships to the core, turning everyone against each other. However, the immediate concern is Görkem’s health. After the chaotic night, they rush Görkem to the hospital, and with the blackmail she inflicted on Fatih, they aren’t trying to fix the situation but rather buy some time. Meanwhile, Kıvılcım feels devastated, on the verge of heading down the wrong path, driven by the sense of betrayal from the man she trusted the most in her life. Shortly after all this chaos, a great tragedy strikes Kıvılcım’s home—Alev dies during childbirth. The child she gave birth to sparks a custody battle between Kıvılcım and Abdullah.

videos.title: Episode 68
videos.overview: Doğa, who is unaware of Giray's affair with his stepmother Heves, thinks that their marriage is on track and tries to keep it that way. Pembe rolls up her sleeves to file for divorce. While Abdullah is trying to take his daughter with him, he is also dealing with the lawsuit filed by Pembe. Meanwhile, Mustafa, who learns that his father was unfair to him while distributing the company shares, turns against him. This situation will cause big storms in the Unals' house as well as in the company. Cemal and Kıvılcım's friendship slowly develops. Kıvılcım realizes that she cannot do anything about the custody of baby Alev and hands the baby over to Abdullah. Görkem, who has tried every way to win her husband back, this time wants to take advantage of the confusion in the company.

videos.title: Episode 104
videos.overview: Months have passed. Although everyone seems to have returned to their normal lives, they still carry the marks of what happened last. Abdullah has constantly questioned himself during this time and, leaning on his already strong faith, has gone on pilgrimage to Umrah. Now, Fatih is at the head of all the business. He is increasingly consumed by the intoxication of power, seeing himself as a true businessman. Because of the fear she experienced on the last night, Kıvılcım gave birth prematurely, and her baby was born very small and is now in the incubator. For this reason, tensions run high between Kıvılcım and Ömer, as Kıvılcım blames the Ünal family. Mustafa has been admitted to a mental hospital for treatment. Nilay, on the other hand, after her trauma, did not want to return to that house and started living with her mother in her own home. Those who believe that everything has somehow settled back into place are in for a huge surprise.

videos.title: Episode 105
videos.overview: While Fatih and Doğa’s relationship continues with constant ups and downs, Doğa has now made up her mind to end it. Asil has begun living with the Asudeler family and, from the moment he enters the company, makes it his mission to challenge Fatih. When his proposal to buy yachts for the hotels is accepted by the board despite Fatih’s opposition, tensions between them escalate further. Nilay continues living with her mother Sevtap, whose old friend from her past adds a new spark to their lives. Meanwhile, Kıvılcım and Ömer, saddened by the troubles of their doctor friends, begin doing everything they can to help them. Işıl, on the other hand, has finally learned how to handle Abdullah—but her past sins continue to haunt her.

videos.title: Episode 106
videos.overview: Işıl wants to find the person threatening her. She first goes to the hospital where Koray is staying, but after seeing his condition, she realizes her suspicions about him were unfounded. She then begins to think that perhaps Mustafa could be behind it. Meanwhile, Nursema and Firaz’s relationship has settled, and Nursema now has only one goal: to have a baby. What she doesn’t know is that Firaz secretly has another lover. Abdullah plans to visit Mustafa, and Nilay and her son accompany him. The father and son’s reunion is sorrowful and emotional. Tension between Fatih and Doğa has reached a breaking point. Doğa says she wants a divorce, but Fatih doesn’t even take it seriously. Asil throws a party on the yacht he acquired for the company and invites everyone. On the other hand, Ömer, while trying to help the son of a friend who got him into trouble, will face a major shock.

videos.title: Episode 108
videos.overview: After receiving a phone call from the person threatening her, Işıl feels completely cornered. However, Asil has already found this person and joined the game himself. Mustafa staying at Nilay’s house doesn’t sit well with Abdullah, who decides to take action to bring them back home. When Işıl agrees to this arrangement for her own benefit and Nilay can’t refuse Abdullah’s request, Mustafa and Nilay return to the family house. Yet, an unpleasant surprise awaits them—Mustafa is told he’ll be staying in the guesthouse. Meanwhile, Kıvılcım experiences a pleasant surprise when Çimen arrives to stay with them for a while, bringing joy and warmth to the household. However, Ömer’s unease persists. He continues fighting to free the young man he believes to be innocent. Eventually, unable to hold it in any longer, he tells Kıvılcım the whole truth.

videos.title: Episode 109
videos.overview: Unable to bear it any longer, Ömer finally confesses the whole truth to Kıvılcım. Now, the two of them must carry this heavy burden together, but it has already begun to take a toll on their relationship. Kıvılcım starts having nightmares. Thanks to Fatih’s efforts, his relationship with Doğa improves slightly, though he continues to clash with Asil. As tensions escalate between them, Asude and Abdullah step in with a plan to put an end to the feud. Believing that Mustafa is the one threatening her, Işıl tries to intimidate him, but she soon realizes she’s mistaken. Meanwhile, Firaz, who is trying to break up with his girlfriend, discovers that walking away won’t be as easy as he thought. Just as things begin to ease between Doğa and Fatih, they end up arguing again, this time because of Çimen. Doğa leaves the house with her daughter,but soon after, she gets into a serious accident.

videos.title: Episode 110
videos.overview: The fact that Doğa and her daughter survive the accident unharmed brings great relief and happiness to everyone. After the incident, Fatih begins treating his wife with more care and tenderness, helping to mend their strained relationship. Meanwhile, Kıvılcım, weighed down by the burden of Ömer’s secret, becomes increasingly tense and irritable, unsure of what to do. Işıl, realizing that even selling her house won’t solve her financial problems, falls into a panic. Firaz, trying to end things amicably with his girlfriend, seeks guidance from Asil, but Demet proves far from easy to deal with. Unable to resist Abidin’s insistence, Asil agrees to meet Sevtap to try and reconcile, only to realize that their relationship can’t be fixed. As the possibility of Çimen falling ill emerges, Kıvılcım, already emotionally fragile, reaches her breaking point. Deciding she can no longer bear the weight of Ömer’s secret, she takes a bold step that will deeply affect everyone around her.

videos.title: Episode 111
videos.overview: After Kıvılcım reports Ömer to the authorities, he is arrested and sent to prison to await trial. Though heartbroken and devastated, Kıvılcım remains certain that she did what was right. However, her decision also casts a shadow over the recently improving relationship between Fatih and Doğa. Meanwhile, Nilay’s appearance in a TV series and Fatih’s participation in a magazine photoshoot bring unexpected excitement to the Ünal household. Seeing that Abdullah is going through a rough period, Işıl decides to accelerate her manipulative plan, first by claiming that her business has gone bankrupt, and then by convincing Abdullah that he’s becoming forgetful. At the same time, Demet, unable to accept her breakup with Firaz, begins plotting revenge. To carry it out, she befriends Nursema and tries to get close to her. And finally, as with every secret affair, the day comes when Işıl and Leo’s forbidden relationship is exposed, threatening to unravel everything they’ve tried to keep hidden.

videos.title: Episode 112
videos.overview: After witnessing Işıl and Leo’s kiss, Nilay becomes a serious threat and it’s up to Işıl to keep her quiet. Meanwhile, Doğa, accompanying her husband to a magazine photoshoot, finds herself once again clinging to the hope that their relationship can be repaired. At the Ünal household, Nursema invites a friend and her husband over for dinner, unaware that the man was once her friend’s ex-boyfriend. The revelation creates visible tension among the guests. Elsewhere, Ömer remains in prison, still unable to forgive his wife for being the reason he’s there and he refuses to see her. Meanwhile, with Asil’s help, Kıvılcım begins to dig into the truth behind the accident, determined to find the real culprit. Unable to keep the secret any longer, Nilay finally tells Mustafa everything she saw and heard. Outraged, Mustafa confronts Asil the one person who already knows the entire truth setting the stage for an explosive showdown.

videos.title: Episode 113
videos.overview: Mustafa confronts Asil after learning the truth from Nilay, and the two make an agreement in which Mustafa must pay a price to obtain the information he wants. Noticing Mustafa’s sudden change in behavior, Işıl pressures Nilay to extract the truth from her. Meanwhile, Nursema and Firaz’s relationship is going smoothly. Firaz decides to surprise his wife with a birthday party, but the unexpected arrival of an uninvited guest turns the celebration into a nightmare. For Firaz, it is the beginning of the end. As Kıvılcım investigates the traffic accident believed to have been caused by Ömer, she finally uncovers the truth with Asil’s help, allowing Ömer to regain his freedom. Armed with the evidence she received from Asil, Mustafa becomes certain of what Işıl has done and sets out to take his revenge.

videos.title: Episode 114
videos.overview: Six months have passed since the boat accident. The Ünal family has suffered three losses and is trying to hold on to one another to survive. Abdullah, Fatih, Nursema, and Nilay now live in the same house. Nilay couldn’t refuse Abdullah, whom she sees as a father, and chose not to return to her mother; she stayed with them. After being released from prison, Ömer did not forgive Kıvılcım and divorced her. He now takes his son with him on weekends. Kıvılcım, devastated by everything that has happened, feels helpless and unable to fix the situation. Abdullah has returned to work. His greatest enemy now is Asil, who triggered the events in order to seize the company’s shares. Ömer, keeping the promise he made to his friend Hikmet in prison, has grown close to Hikmet’s family. Abdullah is deeply affected by Salkım, whom he met on a friend's recommendation. The marriage decision he makes as a result hits the Ünal household like a bomb.

videos.title: Episode 125
videos.overview: On the night Asude and Asil come to ask for Elif's hand, Elif's claim that there is a secret love between Asil and Nursema drops like a bomb on the evening. Ünal's home erupts in chaos, with everyone turning on each other. While this incident brings Nilay and Nursema closer, Abdullah will try to calm everyone down. Bade's deception has been exposed, and Ömer has told her he wants a divorce. Nursema, moving to cover up the scandal in her home, asks for help from İlhami. This situation will bring the two of them closer. Asil, meanwhile, asks Elif for some time to think. Elif is devastated, but there's nothing she can do. At Nilay's shop, she runs into her friend Salkım and asks her to intervene for her son and Nilay. When Salkım eagerly takes on this task, she finds the entire family standing against her. Asil's platform launch night will bring all the families together, and the tension between Fatih and Başak will come fully to the surface during the evening.

videos.title: Episode 126
videos.overview: The tension between Fatih and Başak has now reached an irreversible point, but neither is yet ready for an open conversation. A couple of subtle moves Fatih makes without Başak noticing will prevent their divorce. Bade, on the other hand, will once again devise a scheme to avoid breaking up with Ömer, but this time her ploy won't work. Due to Ramadan, Abdullah sets up a large tent and hosts an iftar dinner. İlhami will confess to his father that he's still in love with Nursema, and Ulvi will be far from pleased about this. Seeing İlhami and Nursema growing closer, Asil decides to speed things up with Elif, who is more than willing to go along with it from the get-go. Salkım's friend's son Yağız doesn't miss a single opportunity to get close to Nilay. While the possibility that Ömer and Kıvılcım's son Kemal might be involved keeps both of them on edge, Nursema and İlhami's wedding day concludes in a surprising way.

videos.title: Episode 127
videos.overview: When it becomes clear that Ömer and Kıvılcım's son Kemal was switched at the hospital, both of them suffer a major blow. However, there's nothing to be done; they decide to return the babies to their real families as soon as possible. Although İlhami's absence from the imam wedding stirs up different thoughts in Nursema, the truth eventually comes out: İlhami has been in an accident and rushed to the hospital. With the company being fumigated, the dog Badi's brief return home adds a splash of color to the Ünallar family's life. Since Kıvılcım is swamped, looking after her friend’s sister Yudum falls to Asil. Yudum starts working as an intern at the channel. Tuncay, having misunderstood, thinks Başak is pregnant. Even though he brings it up in the family setting, Başak clarifies the matter and puts it to rest. There are issues with Emir's work, but he tries to keep it from Çimen. Nilay, finding the letter Nursema wrote, springs into action.

videos.title: Episode 128
videos.overview: Asil, who reads the letter, cannot make it in time before the marriage ceremony. Nursema is now officially married to İlhami. Deciding to turn back from the wrong path he accidentally took, Asil tells Elif that he wants to separate. Elif is devastated, but there's nothing she can do. It's up to her mother Salkım to pick up the pieces of the shattered Elif. Ömer and Kıvılcım are struggling to bond with their new baby. During this time, Ömer stays at the Kıvılcım household. They don't forget the baby they're looking after and go to visit him. Yağız, who has set his mind on caging Nilay, tries to bring them together through their mothers, but Nilay's stance is clear-cut. When Emir can't overcome the troubles at work, he goes to Fatih for advice and decides to follow the path he suggests. While heading to court for the divorce, the fact that Başak is kidnapped from right beside Fatih—and who the kidnapper is—turns out to be a huge surprise.

videos.title: Episode 129
videos.overview: The person who makes Başak flee from Fatih's side while they are heading to court for divorce is none other than Fatih himself. The ice between them melts; they discuss and overcome all their problems, and begin to live their love. Yağız, who tries every possible way to marry Nilay, will approach her this time under the pretext of helping the poor, but still won't get the result he wants. While Nursema and İlhami's marriage is on track but progressing sluggishly, the Abdullahs' arrival for iftar dinner lays all their differences starkly bare. Elif, who has fallen into depression after Asil abandons her, is lashing out at everyone. Emir, unable to halt the downward spiral in his business, will be forced to leave home with Çimen and seek refuge at a friend's place. Even though he still doesn't want to explain the dire situation he's fallen into to anyone, when things become utterly hopeless, he will reach the point of contemplating suicide.

videos.title: Episode 130
videos.overview: Emir, who has lost everything due to his business going badly, has pulled back from the brink of suicide. But he still isn't ready to confess this to either his own family or Çimen's family. Yağız, unable to convince Nilay about marriage, will resort to shady methods to get the job done quickly. Abidin, who has agreed to the marriage under Asil's pressure, is deeply unhappy. Nilay's listlessness draws the attention of everyone in the house, but Nilay can't open up her troubles to anyone. Tuncay's invitation to the whole family to the farm gives the Ünallar family a chance to have a beautiful day. Emir and Çimen, who have ended up in a rundown guesthouse due to lack of money, are going through tough times. While Çimen is left alone, the guesthouse being raided by the police becomes the salt in the wound. Both sides' families learn the truth and clash with each other. Nilay is completely cornered; all escape routes from this marriage have been sealed shut.
